name: Product usage metrics
summary: Internal measurement of how the product is used: engagement, onboarding, project creation and top features, sourced from product analytics events the web app sends.

roles.note: The audience is internal (product, data, marketing, customer success, TechOps). It isn't a customer feature, so no project role applies; it may belong in an internal-operations capability.

nfr.statement: How current the usage dashboard figures are.
nfr.open_question: The PRD asks for real-time KPIs but leaves the refresh frequency open.

requirements.title: Usage dashboard for engagement, onboarding and features
requirements.statement: A dashboard shows active users and the DAU/MAU ratio, successful signup and onboarding completion rates, project creation success with drop-off points, and the top features used, with filters. It copes with no data and with high volumes, and accounts for bot traffic.
requirements.rationale: PRD only for the dashboard; grouped from the metrics and product metrics PRDs. The data would come from the existing analytics events (PROG-REQ-081). Third-party marketing integration and historical migration are out of scope.

sources.title: Prior PRDs - Safety monitoring, segmentation and product metrics (t3d-prd-agent prd-organised)
sources.at: analytics-and-metrics.md FR-001..FR-004, AC-001..AC-004, EC-002; metrics.md FR-001..FR-003, EC-001, EC-002

acceptance_criteria.when: The user views the engagement section
acceptance_criteria.then: Active users and the DAU/MAU ratio are shown

acceptance_criteria.given: A filter on a date range with no events
acceptance_criteria.then: The dashboard says there is no data instead of failing

requirements.title: Analytics profiles carry the user's email, name and job title
requirements.statement: When analytics is switched on for the web app, each signed-in user is identified to the analytics service by their user ID with their email, full name and job title, and product events are tracked against that profile.
requirements.rationale: Current behaviour. Personal data goes to a third-party analytics service; whether that is covered by the privacy notice and customer agreements was not checked.

sources.title: Direct code reads during USER migration (2026-10-29)
Direct code reads during USER migration (2026-10-29)

open_checks: Confirm which environments set the analytics flag and whether profile data sharing is disclosed

acceptance_criteria.given: Analytics is enabled and a user signs in
acceptance_criteria.then: The analytics profile is set with their ID, email, name and job title
